motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default card and button state transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary CTA button using teal action color.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0d7d71; color: #fff; padding: 0.8rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #07635b; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(13,125,113,0.22); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 0.2rem; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action button with transparent background.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #111318; border: 1.5px solid #e4e4e7; padding: 0.8rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #0f172a; color: #0f172a; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 0.2rem; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Standard content card with optional raised state.
components.html:
Step 1

Write the smallest version of what you want to learn or build.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; border-radius: 0.35rem; padding: 1.25rem; background: #ffffff; } .ds-card-raised { background: #f8f8fa; } .ds-card-interactive { cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-card-interactive:hover { border-color: #0d7d71; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(17,19,24,0.08); } .ds-card-title { font-family: Merriweather, Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.25; color: #0f172a; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; } .ds-card-body { color: #5b5f6b; margin-top: 0.35rem; } .ds-card-interactive:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 0.2rem; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Minimal top navigation with brand and active state.

narrative.overview: testsite is a clean studio for practical AI workflow tutorials. Its design system prioritizes readability, reuse, and restraint over decorative visuals.
keyCharacteristics: Token-first styling with minimal inline exceptions
Editorial typography using Merriweather and Inter
Restrained teal accent with neutral surfaces
Clear card hierarchy and consistent spacing

rules.name: The Restraint Rule
rules.body: Accent color appears on meaningful actions only; avoid decorative saturation.

rules.name: The One Type Rule
rules.body: One heading role per section; avoid stacking multiple heading weights in the same card.

rules.name: The Flat Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; elevation appears only for cards in raised states or hover/focus emphasis.

dos: Do keep inline styles out of page markup; prefer shared utilities and tokens.
Do preserve visible focus states for nav, buttons, and cards.
Do use restrained accent color only at action points.
donts: Don't add decorative gradients or heavy imagery unless they reinforce the clean studio metaphor.
Don't introduce new accent colors without mapping them to a token.
Don't weaken typographic hierarchy by equalizing card weights.
